decisions.reason: Replacing controlled fields with simple editable text may invalidate automatic clear-on-click behavior, but the accepted architecture does not explicitly determine whether that behavior is removed or must be implemented by another mechanism.
The representation change does not necessarily remove the requirement for a visible editable-area cue or determine whether the accepted grey appearance should change.
Persistent help labels can remain required for simple editable text areas; the source decision does not change or remove them.
The ordinary text-entry representation does not change the required stability of legacy-content copy and paste.
The controlled theme-color requirement is independent of whether ordinary text entry uses content controls.
Changing ordinary text-entry architecture does not alter pasted-table containment or layout-stability requirements.
Bullet sizing, balance, alignment, reference design, and color remain unaffected by the text-entry representation.
Tab-based list hierarchy is independent of the representation selected for ordinary text-entry fields.
The source decision does not change the required language of style names or other template interface text.
Named-style font sizes, weights, and caption typography are unaffected by the ordinary text-entry architecture.
